text:
We messaged them initially, but they didn't reply or replied very slowly. So we called to ask about the price of a filling. Another person answered and said we had to pay upfront and claim it from social security. The price for a filling starts at 100-2,000 baht. Then, another staff member, who seemed to have just seen the message, replied that the clinic doesn't require upfront payment; it can be deducted from social security, and the starting price is 800 baht. We were confused. Is this even the same clinic? They're giving conflicting prices and information. If we actually go there, will the price be accurate? We told the admin that the inconsistent pricing would confuse customers, but the admin didn't apologize at all, only replying, "Okay."
Good job! Excellent! Have more admins like this, and you'll get more customers!

They make customers wait for 1.5 hours without calling them, and even let people who arrived later go in first.
